# Grammatical Tense

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:GrammaticalTense`](gmeow-GrammaticalTense.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/GrammaticalTense>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/events`](../../slices/events.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The grammatical tense of an event mention in text — a VALUE vocabulary for ISO-TimeML interoperability (past / present / future / none). Describes the linguistic realization, not the occurrence.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:GrammaticalTense`](gmeow-GrammaticalTense.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the value vocabulary for the grammatical-tense axis of an event MENTION in text (past / present / future / none) — strictly for ISO-TimeML interoperability.

### Avoid when

- Avoid using it to express WHEN an event occurred (that is [`gmeow:eventTime`](../properties/gmeow-eventTime.md) / [`eventInterval`](../properties/gmeow-eventInterval.md)); tense describes a textual realization and must never be inferred from, or used to infer, actual temporal placement.

### How to use

- Reference a [`gmeow:GrammaticalTense`](gmeow-GrammaticalTense.md) individual from a textual event mention via [`gmeow:eventTense`](../properties/gmeow-eventTense.md); keep it on the annotation layer, orthogonal to the event's real dating.

### Examples

- ex:mention [`gmeow:eventTense`](../properties/gmeow-eventTense.md) [`gmeow:tensePast`](../individuals/gmeow-tensePast.md).
